message.reasoning:
We need to write test cases for uncovered exception scenarios. Identify all possible exception scenarios in method.

Looking at code: possible exceptions:
- NullPointerException if executionContext null, node null, rootNode null, at null? The code uses executionContext.getCollectorContext() -> NPE if executionContext null. Also collectorContext.enterDynamicScope() could NPE if collectorContext null.
- JsonSchemaException thrown when failFast true and numberOfValidSchema != 1. That's already covered partially (failFast true). But maybe also when failFast true and numberOfValidSchema >1 (multiple valid) already covered? Yes multiple valid with failFast true covered. Also failFast true with 0 valid covered. So exception scenarios covered.

Other exception: If schema.validate or schema.walk throws exception (e.g., RuntimeException). Not covered. Should test that exception propagates? The code doesn't catch schema errors; they would bubble up, causing method to exit, but need to ensure scope merging? There's finally block for each schema that merges scope only if schemaErrors.isEmpty(). If exception thrown before schemaErrors assigned, then parentScope may not be exited? Actually try-finally ensures exitDynamicScope called. If schema.validate throws, schemaErrors remains empty? Actually schemaErrors not set; but finally will exit scope and since schemaErrors.isEmpty() maybe true (since initialized empty), then parentScope.mergeWith(scope). However exception propagates out of loop, then outer finally merges grandParentScope only if errors.isEmpty(). But errors set is still empty because exception thrown before adding errors. So exception propagates.

Thus we need test cases for:
- executionContext null -> NPE.
- node null -> maybe schema.validate called with null node; may cause NPE inside schema.validate, but method itself may not check. But we can test that passing null node leads to NullPointerException from state.setComplexValidator? Actually state retrieved from collectorContext; not using node. But schema.validate may NPE; not our method. However we can test that method throws NullPointerException when node is null and schemas list empty? It will still go through loop but no schemas, so node not used. So maybe no NPE. But executionContext null is immediate NPE.

- collectorContext null (executionContext returns null) leads to NPE when calling collectorContext.enterDynamicScope(). So test that.

- schemas list contains null element -> NullPointerException when iterating and calling schema.validate on null. Not covered.

- schema.validate throws JsonSchemaException? Actually JsonSchemaException is a runtime exception? It extends RuntimeException maybe. But we can test that exception propagates.

Also test that when failFast true and numberOfValidSchema ==1 (i.e., valid) no exception thrown. Already covered indirectly.

Edge case: when failFast true and numberOfValidSchema !=1 but errors set empty? Already covered.

Potential exception: If at is null, used in buildValidationMessage(at, ...) maybe NPE inside buildValidationMessage? Not sure. But we can treat as exception scenario.

Thus we need to add test cases for uncovered exception scenarios: null executionContext, null collectorContext, null schema in list, schema.validate throws runtime exception, schema.walk throws runtime exception, etc.

We must group test cases by test function name. Use new group names.

Provide JSON array with groups and cases.

Each case includes input parameters with values (string descriptions). Provide expected exception.

Let's craft.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - null executionContext
Case: executionContext null, node mock, rootNode mock, at "/path". Expected NullPointerException.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - executionContext with null collectorContext
Case: mockExecutionContext(withNullCollectorContext...), expected NullPointerException.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - schema list contains null element
Case: validator with schemas list containing null, executionContext mock, etc. Expected NullPointerException when calling schema.validate.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - schema.validate throws RuntimeException
Case: validator with schema that throws RuntimeException during validate, expect RuntimeException propagated.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - schema.walk throws RuntimeException (walk enabled)
Case: validator with walk enabled, schema throws RuntimeException, expect RuntimeException.

Group: OneOfValidator.validate - at parameter null leading to NullPointerException in buildValidationMessage
Case: at null, expect NullPointerException.

Make sure not duplicate existing groups.
